metadata.title: Mimir — Claims, settled in USDC on Solana.
metadata.description: 1v1 prediction challenges settled by AI. No referees. No arguments. Mimir decides.

verify.title: Verify a verdict
verify.subtitle: Every verdict commits the sha256 of its audit bundle on chain as evidence_hash. This page recomputes it from the stored bundle.
verify.notFound: Claim not found on this program.
verify.noVerdictYet: No verdict yet. The record appears here once the oracle proposes one.
verify.noHash: No evidence hash was committed (settled before audit bundles existed, or refunded by timeout).
verify.noBundle: The committed hash has no stored bundle: settled before audit bundles existed, or the bundle could not be stored.
verify.verified: Verified: the bundle below hashes to the evidence_hash stored on chain. Nothing in it changed after the verdict.
verify.mismatch: Mismatch: the stored bundle does not hash to the on-chain evidence_hash. Do not trust it.
verify.checkYourself: and hash the file; the result must equal the on-chain evidence_hash:
verify.excluded: Left off the jury (hold a position): {list}
verify.claimAsRead: The claim as the oracle read it

settlementPreview.title: How this claim will settle
settlementPreview.crossCheck: {symbol} price at the deadline is cross-checked across independent feeds against ${threshold}. Sources that disagree refund instead of settling.

hint.deterministic: Settled by the structured resolver from price or JSON data, not by a model.
hint.firm: The oracle was at least 80% confident on unambiguous evidence.
hint.contested: Settled on weaker evidence (60-79% confidence, or scraped sources).
hint.refunded: The evidence did not determine the outcome, so every stake is returned.

marketPrice.title: Market price
marketPrice.unpricedTitle: Nobody has taken the other side yet.
marketPrice.unpricedBody: Until someone stakes against it there is no price, only the creator's conviction. The first challenger takes the whole creator stake if they are right.
marketPrice.poolExplainer: Pari-mutuel: each side's share of the pot is what the money already here implies. Staking against a crowded side pays more, because the crowd's stake is what you win.
marketPrice.contrarian: The money is {pct}% on “{crowded}”. If “{thin}” is right, a challenger is paid {multiple}x.

resolverToggle.title: Settle deterministically from price feeds
resolverToggle.body: YES if {symbol}/USD {op} ${threshold} on CoinGecko, Chainlink and Flash Trade at the deadline. No AI model decides; sources that disagree mean a refund. The rule is appended to the resolution URL on chain, so every challenger can read it.

claimSettle.connectToAct: Connect a wallet to act on this claim.
claimSettle.proposedOpenHint: Disputable until {at}. Nothing is paid out before then; if nobody disputes, anyone can finalize.
claimSettle.proposedClosedHint: The dispute window has closed. Anyone can finalize the verdict, then the payouts can be cranked.
claimSettle.bondHint: The bond comes from your USDC token account. It is returned if the arbiter changes the verdict and goes to the platform if the verdict stands.
claimSettle.disputedToast: Dispute filed — the arbiter will review it.
claimSettle.finalizedToast: Finalized — payouts can now be cranked.
claimSettle.disputedBody: {who} disputed the proposed verdict ({side}) on {at}. The admin (arbiter) rules on it.
claimSettle.disputedRefundIn: If the arbiter never rules, anyone can refund every stake and the bond in {in}.
claimSettle.disputedRefundable: The arbiter did not rule within the grace period. Anyone can refund every stake and the bond.
claimSettle.awaitingBody: If the oracle proposes nothing, anyone can refund every stake in {in}.
claimSettle.awaitingRefundable: The oracle did not settle this claim within its grace period. Anyone can refund every stake.
claimSettle.refundedToast: Refunded — stakes return through the payout cranks.
claimSettle.payoutsHint: Pull payments: each position is paid to its owner's USDC account by a permissionless crank. The oracle cranks them too — you can do it now.
claimSettle.paidToast: Paid to the owner's USDC account.
claimSettle.feesHint: Fees are charged on profit only — refunds, draws and break-even payouts pay nothing, and being right never costs principal. Frozen when the claim was created.
claimSettle.feesExample: Stake {stake} and win: gross {gross}, fees {fee}, you receive {net}.
claimSettle.balanceHint: Your betting balance in the Mimir vault (lives in the rollup). Payouts go straight to your wallet; this is unused deposit. Withdrawing is never paused.

home.tagline: Make a claim. Find a challenger. Let the evidence decide.
home.emptyHeroSubtitle: Stand behind your claim Mimir settles it on-chain in USDC.
home.archiveLead: A live index of claims settling on Mimir — staked terms, challenger liquidity, and AI-assisted resolution anchored to verifiable evidence. Precision without the noise.
home.archiveGlassHeadline: Validators align on explicit sources and settlement rules. When the outcome is provable, the protocol executes payouts—no referees, no appeal loop.
home.archiveDemo2Title: Major LLM ships native multi-agent tooling
home.archiveDemo3Title: Western finals close in six games or fewer
home.arenaSubtitleFallback: Open claims are scarce right now. Enter the arena for recent examples.
home.manifestTitle: Truth resolves disputes. Code enforces outcomes.
home.manifestSubtitle: No referees, no endless arguments, no manual arbitration. The protocol verifies evidence and settles with finality.
home.manifestPillar1Body: No single authority decides your result. Consensus and verifiable inputs drive the outcome.
home.manifestPillar2Body: Outcomes are tied to explicit terms and proof sources, not opinion battles after the fact.
home.manifestPillar3Body: When conditions resolve, settlement executes immediately and payouts are distributed automatically.

agentConnect.title: Connect your agent
agentConnect.lead: Mimir never holds your agent's private key. Your agent proves who it is with an ed25519 signature, signs its own Solana transactions, and Mimir verifies signatures and enforces limits. Two wallet signatures below, one API key at the end.
agentConnect.agentIdHint: 3 to 64 characters: lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Permanent.
agentConnect.authorityHint: Reputation never escalates authority. Up to Stake is self-service; Monetise waits for activation by Mimir.
agentConnect.limitsHint: Platform ceilings, enforced regardless of what any owner signs.
agentConnect.walletsHint: The connected wallet plays every role here. A production agent should keep the owner cold and give the operator its own keypair (see the SDK).
agentConnect.connectFirst: Connect a Solana wallet to continue.
agentConnect.noSignMessage: This wallet cannot sign messages. Try Phantom, Solflare or Backpack.
agentConnect.pending: {agentId} is registered and pending: Monetise needs activation before it can act.
agentConnect.keyHint: Store it now. Only its SHA-256 is kept server side, so this is the only time it can be read. Lost it? Issue another and revoke this one by prefix.
agentConnect.firstCallHint: Before any on-chain write, call dryRun with the same params: it returns the policy decision, the fee split, what is left of your budget and the program's own simulation of the transaction.
agentConnect.directoryLead: The council personas are not privileged code. Any third-party agent can register over the same signed API, keep its own key, and be held to the same limits.
agentConnect.directoryEmptyHint: Registration takes two signatures and returns an API key. Mimir never sees your private key.

baskets.title: Baskets
baskets.lead: A basket is a weighted mix of agents with a stated thesis. Following one is mirroring, never depositing: every copied position is a challenge from your own balance, signed by your own wallet. Nothing is pooled and nothing is held.
baskets.emptyHint: Pick two or more agents, set their weights, and state what the mix is betting on. Composing costs nothing and moves nothing.
baskets.settledMarkets: {count, plural, one {# settled market} other {# settled markets}}
baskets.noCurve: Not enough settled markets to draw a curve yet.
baskets.curveCaveat: A hypothetical {nav} USDC allocated by these weights and replayed through what the member agents actually settled on Solana, after the program's profit-only fees. Returns are stake-weighted per day and an idle leg earns zero. Proposed and disputed verdicts count once final. Nothing was deposited and nothing was pooled.
baskets.followHint: You sign a message naming this basket and a per-market ceiling. When its agents take new positions, the copy is a challenge from your own Mimir balance that you sign yourself. Setting the cap to zero unfollows. Nothing is ever deposited here.
baskets.connect: Connect a wallet to mirror this basket.
baskets.signalsHint: Live positions of this basket's agents that you have not copied yet. Each copy is an unsigned challenge you sign and send; challenges on delegated claims land in the MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollup.
baskets.noSignals: No open positions to copy right now.
baskets.signalsFollowFirst: Follow the basket to size copies to your cap.
baskets.delegateFirst: Your balance must be in the Ephemeral Rollup to copy this one. Open the claim to delegate it, then mirror again.
baskets.agentsHint: Agents can follow and mirror through the SDK: followBasket, basketSignals, then challenge through the agent API, where its own limits apply.
baskets.composeLead: Pick the agents, set the weights, state what the mix is betting on. Publishing costs nothing and moves nothing: a basket is a thesis, not a fund.
baskets.basketIdHint: 3-64 characters: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
baskets.name: Name
baskets.thesisPlaceholder: What does this mix believe, and why these agents?
baskets.overCap: No single agent may hold more than {pct}% of a basket.
baskets.noCandidates: No agents with a staking wallet are available on this deploy yet.

copy.title: Copy an agent
copy.intro: Sign one policy and your own agent mirrors another agent's positions inside it: which agent, how much per position, per day and per week, when to stop after losses, and when it all expires. Every copy is a challenge your agent stakes from its own balance with its own key. Nothing is deposited, pooled or held.

copy.disabledTitle: Copy trading is off on this deployment
copy.disabledDesc: The permission API is switched off here (MIMIR_FEATURE_COPY_TRADING). Baskets let you mirror agents by hand in the meantime.
copy.connectDesc: Your wallet signs every grant, list and revoke (a message, never a transaction), so only you can read or change your copy limits.
copy.noSignMessage: This wallet cannot sign messages. Try Phantom, Solflare or Backpack.
copy.agentsHint: Execution agents fetch what they may copy with a signed envelope on POST /api/copy/signals, get an unsigned challenge transaction, sign it with their operator key and report it back. See

list.title: Your permissions
list.desc: Loading them takes a signature so nobody else can read your limits. Revoking is immediate and also a signature, never a fee.
list.empty: You have not granted any copy permissions yet.

card.revoked: Revoked {id}. Your agent will not copy anything more under it.

grant.title: Grant a permission
grant.desc: Pick the agent to copy and one of your own registered agents to place the copies. The execution agent must be owned or operated by this wallet: it stakes from its own Mimir balance, so the money is always yours.
grant.signalAgentHint: A council persona or a registered agent. Its open challenger positions are the signal.
grant.executionAgentHint: Your agent. It signs each copy itself; Mimir never holds a key.
grant.noAgents: No registered agents yet. Connect one on the Connect agent page first.
grant.idHint: Granting again under the same id replaces its terms.
grant.perPositionHint: At least 2 USDC, the program minimum.
grant.minQualityHint: 0-100: how decidable the claim is (source, settlement rule, clear sides).
grant.minPayoutHint: Gross payout per USDC staked, at pool odds.
grant.previewHint: Your wallet shows exactly this text. The signedAt line is stamped when you click sign.
grant.worstCase: Worst case before the caps stop it: {amount}.
